branches.suggestion: I'm learning the days of the week! Monday, Tuesday… um… what's next?
branches.suggestionFa: دارم روزهای هفته را یاد می‌گیرم! دوشنبه، سه‌شنبه… اِم… بعدی چیه؟

branches.suggestion: Wednesday is a funny word. Wed-nes-day. Why is there a "d"?
branches.suggestionFa: چهارشنبه کلمهٔ بامزه‌ایه. Wed-nes-day. چرا یه «d» داره؟

r3.speaker: mehdi
r3.text: Nobody knows! You don't say it.

branches.suggestion: Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday! Saturday and Sunday are the weekend. I love the weekend!
branches.suggestionFa: پنجشنبه، جمعه، شنبه، یکشنبه! شنبه و یکشنبه آخر هفته‌ان. عاشق آخر هفته‌ام!

branches.suggestion: Friday? That's strange! What do you do on Fridays?
branches.suggestionFa: جمعه؟ عجیبه! جمعه‌ها چی کار می‌کنید؟

r5.speaker: mehdi
r5.text: We visit family and have a big lunch.

translations.fa: به خانواده سر می‌زنیم و یه ناهار مفصل می‌خوریم.

branches.suggestion: Mountains! On Saturdays I have ballet. What day is your English class?
branches.suggestionFa: کوه! من شنبه‌ها باله دارم. کلاس انگلیسیت چه روزیه؟

branches.suggestion: Thursday! Tomorrow is Friday! On Fridays we have fish and chips.
branches.suggestionFa: پنجشنبه! فردا جمعه‌ست! جمعه‌ها فیش اند چیپس داریم.

branches.suggestion: Yes! Every Friday from the chippy. Daddy says it's the law!
branches.suggestionFa: آره! هر جمعه از چیپس‌فروشی. بابا می‌گه قانونه!

r9.speaker: mehdi
r9.text: Ha ha! Your daddy is funny.

branches.suggestion: Yes, come on Friday! Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday! I did it!
branches.suggestionFa: آره، جمعه بیا! دوشنبه، سه‌شنبه، چهارشنبه، پنجشنبه، جمعه، شنبه، یکشنبه! تونستم!
